# references

dth-sc's bibliography: one folio-reference/v1 CSL-JSON node per entry of the document's [References](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#reference) chapter (`folio/dth-sc/references/p-references-page-065.md`), `<key>.json`, in the KG at `references/<key>` (owner, 2026-11-02: "each document should have a bibliography pages which includes refrenced content in the document"). Committee content, wording kept: each node's fields are taken word for word from its entry, and `_comment` holds the entry as printed. A key shared with the who-iris catalogue, a library asset or another folio's bibliography names the same work there.
